issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

mediumRiskPercentage.description:
Specifies the percentage of {@link Sensor}s greater than this value in a {@link ProtectionLoop} that need
an issue for a {@link ProtectionLoop} to be at medium risk. Value should be between 0 and 1 and less than
the high or equal to the {@link #highRiskPercentage}.

highRiskPercentage.description:
Specifies the percentage of {@link Sensor}s greater than this value in a {@link ProtectionLoop} that need
an issue for a {@link ProtectionLoop} to be at high risk. Value should be between 0 and 1.

highLowLookbackPeriod.description: The lookback period for evaluating sensor protection loop low-low and high-high threshold logic.

protectionLoopAlertClosePeriod.description: The amount of time that needs to have passed for {@link ProtectionLoopAlert}s to be automatically closed.
